fields.calculatedFormula:
IF(
  OR(
    ISBLANK(Total_Funding_Raised__c),
    ISBLANK(Months_Since_Last_Financing__c)
  ),
  NULL,
  Total_Funding_Raised__c * ( 0.971531941 ^ Months_Since_Last_Financing__c )
)
fields.label: Effective Funding Today
fields.name: Effective_Funding_Today__c

fields.calculatedFormula:
IF(
  ISBLANK(Date_of_Last_Financing__c),
  NULL,
  MAX(
    0,
    (YEAR(TODAY()) - YEAR(Date_of_Last_Financing__c)) * 12
    + (MONTH(TODAY()) - MONTH(Date_of_Last_Financing__c))
    - IF(DAY(TODAY()) < DAY(Date_of_Last_Financing__c), 1, 0)
  )
)

fields.label: Funding to Target Ratio
fields.name: Funding_to_Target_Ratio__c

fields.calculatedFormula:
IF(
  ISPICKVAL(Ownership_Status__c, "Out of Business"),
  "Out of Business",
  IF(
    ISPICKVAL(Ownership_Status__c, "Public"),
    "Public",
    IF(
      ISPICKVAL(Ownership_Status__c, "Acquired/Merged"),
      "Acquired/Merged",
      IF(
        ISPICKVAL(Ownership_Status__c, "Operating Subsidiary"),
        "Operating Subsidiary",
        IF(
          ISPICKVAL(Ownership_Status__c, "Private (no backing)"),
          "Bootstrapped",
          /* else: derive from funding ratio */
          IF(
            OR(
              ISBLANK(Total_Funding_Raised__c),
              Total_Funding_Raised__c = 0
            ),
            "Unknown Ratio",
            IF(
              ISBLANK(Funding_to_Target_Ratio__c),
              NULL,
                IF(
                  Funding_to_Target_Ratio__c >= 1, "Overfunded",
                  IF(
                    Funding_to_Target_Ratio__c >= 0.75, "At Target",
                    "Light"
                )
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
)
fields.label: LS2 Funding Bucket
fields.name: LS2_Funding_Bucket__c

fields.calculatedFormula:
IF(
  ISBLANK(SS_12_Month_Growth__c),
  NULL,
  IF(
    LS2_Size_Bucket__c = "Micro",
    IF(SS_12_Month_Growth__c >= 0.50, "Growing",
       IF(SS_12_Month_Growth__c >= 0, "Flat", "Declining")),
    IF(
      LS2_Size_Bucket__c = "Small",
      IF(SS_12_Month_Growth__c >= 0.40, "Growing",
         IF(SS_12_Month_Growth__c >= 0, "Flat", "Declining")),
      IF(
        LS2_Size_Bucket__c = "Medium",
        IF(SS_12_Month_Growth__c >= 0.30, "Growing",
           IF(SS_12_Month_Growth__c >= 0, "Flat", "Declining")),
        IF(
          LS2_Size_Bucket__c = "Large",
          IF(SS_12_Month_Growth__c >= 0.20, "Growing",
             IF(SS_12_Month_Growth__c >= 0, "Flat", "Declining")),
          IF(
            OR(LS2_Size_Bucket__c = "Extra Large", LS2_Size_Bucket__c = "XL"),
            IF(SS_12_Month_Growth__c >= 0.15, "Growing",
               IF(SS_12_Month_Growth__c >= 0, "Flat", "Declining")),
            IF(
              LS2_Size_Bucket__c = "Too Big",
              IF(SS_12_Month_Growth__c >= 0.10, "Growing",
                 IF(SS_12_Month_Growth__c >= 0, "Flat", "Declining")),
              /* Fallback for blank/unexpected Size: use Micro thresholds */
              IF(SS_12_Month_Growth__c >= 0.50, "Growing",
                 IF(SS_12_Month_Growth__c >= 0, "Flat", "Declining"))
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
)
